locator.identity_review: All four baseline identity layers were checked: 1,282 sites, 1,391 projects, both 231 identity-mapping records and 231 decisions, and 231 preserved source records. AngoNAP, Angola Cables, Trajano and the named legal identifiers have no matches. The nearest existing geometry is Scala Praia do Futuro, 1.630 km from the point to its polygon, followed by Tecto TFOR3 at 2.697 km and Ascenty FTZ01 at 19.669 km. Distances include all geometry types using a WGS84 azimuthal-equidistant projection centered on the candidate. These are distinct host addresses. AngoNAP Luanda is in Angola; the separate MONET cable landing station at Pintor Antônio Bandeira 2630 is not this parcel. Network equipment, office and internal expansion are not extra sites.
